about: The only call sites allowed to make a paid Jev call, read by ops/typesafe_client.py before any transport. An unregistered caller, a call without the site's attribution, or a site marked unattended=off inside a CARR_JEV_WORKER=off worker is refused and logged, never paid. Budgets are per UTC hour and per UTC day per site, under hourly_paid_call_cap and jev-cost-guard's daily_paid_call_cap. `caller` is the module that called ask()/judge() (file name without .py) or an explicit caller= string. A new paid call path fails ops/jev-call-sites-selftest.py until it has an entry here. Audit and per-site decisions: the 2026-10-04 PR 'Jev: system-wide call audit, call-site registry and budgets'.

sites.trigger: UserPromptSubmit on a human prompt (machine envelopes are skipped): one ranking + one batched binding request over pack rules the compiled triggers did not match
sites.runs_in: interactive Claude and Codex sessions via hooks/rule-pack-preuse-reselection.py
sites.value: judged rules reached the session beyond the compiled match on 9% of human prompts (234 of ~2,560, 2026-09-27..10-04); worker briefs are machine-written and fall back to the deterministic overlap pick

sites.value: 15,663 calls in 7 days before retirement, 14 on 2026-10-04; kept registered at a token budget so a stray caller is bounded rather than silent
